author: Ankit
problem: Read a string S of the letters A, B and C. Print Yes if S is some A's, then some B's, then some C's (each part may be empty), otherwise No.
bug_description: Only allows moving to the very next letter, so strings that skip the B part, like 'AACC', get No.

comments.accurate: Checks that the letters never go backwards: A's, then B's, then C's
comments.wrong_behavior: Letters must step through A, B, C in order without skipping a letter
comments.wrong_location: Letter transitions verified; check the starting letter when S begins with B or C

source.buggy_line: elif x-1 == code_point and x == code_point + 1:
source.fixed_line: elif x == code_point + 1 or x == code_point + 2:
